# GitHub Configuration

## Inputs
- Issue structure definitions, milestone gates, and PR linking conventions.

## Process
- Maintains standardized GitHub issue templates enforcing goals, task checklists, acceptance criteria, scope restrictions, and milestone acceptance criteria.
- Maintains pull request templates ensuring evidence verification, scope auditing, and strict issue resolution linking.
- Maintains CI automation workflows for automated linting (Ruff) and security auditing (Bandit).

## Outputs
- Reusable milestone templates in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE.md` and `.github/pull_request_template.md`.
- Automated CI pipeline in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
